title: mimi-00: example of full TLS encoding (JM-2)
description: Mark decided (via mimid-13, 2026-10-18): keyPackageRef / invalidProposals are unpadded base64url of the full TLS presentation-language encoding, varint length prefix included. Add an example showing octets (with prefix) and the resulting base64url. Compute the example independently (not by hand-guessing); RFC 9420 §2.1.2 varint.
